title: 창가 한 자리
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. A fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern in C major at 72 BPM. A clean electric guitar provides ambient swells and melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. The male lead vocal is breathy and intimate, sitting forward in the mix with subtle plate reverb. A warm, round electric bass enters during the second verse, playing melodic lines that emphasize the root and fifth. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal performance.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
형광등 아래
우산들이
서 있다
4월의 누군가 두고 간 것 [clean electric guitar swells]
노란 줄기가
낡아 있다
아마 그날 비가 왔겠지
기억은 여기
남아 있다

[Verse 2]
[electric bass enters]
6월의 하늘색 우산
반납용 스티커가
붙어 있다
